Implemented the variable-cell trajectory fix.

The root cause was `NoJump` retaining stale traversal history when frame 0 was presented again by the normal MDAnalysis API. This caused the continuity checker to reset at the following frame, potentially leaving a full-cell jump uncorrected. Frame 0 now explicitly initializes a fresh reduced-coordinate history while arbitrary first-frame access and non-sequential diagnostics remain supported.

Changes:

- Updated [`nojump.py`](/workspace/task/source/package/MDAnalysis/transformations/nojump.py:126) to reset state coherently at the start of every traversal.
- Added regression coverage in [`test_nojump.py`](/workspace/task/source/testsuite/MDAnalysisTests/transformations/test_nojump.py:126) for:
  - Changing orthorhombic and triclinic cells
  - Multiple atoms
  - Positive and negative boundary crossings
  - Two complete trajectory traversals
  - Exact variable-cell reduced-coordinate recurrence

- `python reproduce.py`: both schedules now have `max_frame_step: 0.0` and no warnings.
- Full transformations suite: `182 passed`.
- Randomized orthorhombic/triclinic changing-cell checks passed for 23 atoms and 18 frames across repeated traversals.
